description: This file defines a static class 'DbExtensions' providing an extension method 'AddDatabase' to configure and register the application's database context with dependency injection, specifically setting up MySQL using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: DbExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add database configurations.

methods.name: AddDatabase
methods.description: Extension method to configure and add the database context 'AppDbContext' to the service collection using MySQL and connection string from configuration.
